description: Test suite for the 'litellm_core_utils.llm_cost_calc.tool_call_cost_tracking' module, focusing on cost calculation functions related to web search, file search, and other built-in tools within the Litellm project. Uses pytest and unittest.mock for testing various scenarios and edge cases.

classes.name: ModelResponse
classes.description: Represents a response object typically returned from a language model API, including choices and usage metadata.

classes.name: Choices
classes.description: Represents individual choices in a model response, including finish reason, message, and index.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Contains the content and role of a message in a chat completion response.

classes.name: WebSearchOptions
classes.description: Specifies options for web search, such as search context size.

classes.name: FileSearchTool
classes.description: Defines the structure for a file search tool, with a type attribute.

classes.name: ServerToolUse
classes.description: Holds information about server tool usage, such as number of web search requests.

classes.name: Usage
classes.description: Captures usage details for a model, such as tokens used and web search requests.

classes.name: PromptTokensDetailsWrapper
classes.description: Wraps token details, including web search requests, for usage tracking.
